evals.prompt: buatkan website kedai kopi saya di Bandung. terserah kamu
evals.expected_output: Autopilot run: inventory, rut, deal, three rendered concepts, locked DESIGN.md/BRAND.md, copy deck, built index.html that passes both gates, fresh-context critique, honest report in Indonesian.
expectations: design/inventory.md lists at least 8 items spanning at least 3 families, with inferred items marked ASSUMPTION
design/decisions.md has a ledger line for every phase 0-9 (or N/A with a reason)
scripts/deal.mjs was run and its seed is recorded in DESIGN.md §0
DESIGN.md §0 contains an idea sentence of the form 'On this page, X becomes Y' and a competitor test result
The page ground is not warm cream (inspect.sh reports no cream-ground warning) unless DESIGN.md gives a subject-derived reason
No font from the reflex list in tells.md §4 is used without a written reason
The h1 is 2 lines or fewer at 1440, 768 and 390 (inspect.sh headline-lines has no FAIL)
The final inspect.sh run reports 0 FAIL and brand-check.mjs reports 0 errors
No invented testimonials, ratings, customer counts or press logos appear; unconfirmed facts use [FILL: ...]
The page has a live thing (an interaction using real content) with a no-JS fallback
The critique was produced by a fresh subagent, or is explicitly marked DEGRADED
The final report is in Indonesian and lists every FILL/REPLACE/SAMPLE slot

evals.prompt: Landing page for Ledgerline, an API that reconciles Stripe payouts with bank statements for small accounting firms. Primary action: book a demo. We have real product screenshots in assets/ui/.
evals.expected_output: A Precision/Structured style page whose hero shows the real product UI, avoiding the near-black + neon and purple-gradient ruts.
expectations: The rut section names both the category default (dark + purple/neon gradient, 3 feature cards) and a predictable opposite
deal.mjs was run with --have product-ui
The hero uses the real product UI from assets/ui/ rather than an illustration or a fake grey-bar dashboard
There is no row of three identical icon feature cards
There are no gradient text, glow, or backdrop-filter glass panels (inspect.sh WARN list has none of gradient-text, glass)
The primary button says what happens (e.g. 'Book a 20-minute demo'), not 'Get started' or 'Learn more'
Light or dark ground is justified by a written use-scene sentence

evals.prompt: Make a site for our dental clinic. Here is our brand guide: our colour is #0B5D3B, we always use the font Inter, and we address patients as 'Anda'.
evals.expected_output: Import mode: brand values LOCKED; Inter in fonts.locked so it is not flagged; address form Anda enforced; concepts vary in composition only.
expectations: Import mode ran first and design/BRAND.md lists the colour, Inter and the address form as LOCKED
brand.json lists Inter in fonts.locked and fonts.allowed, and voice.addressForm is 'Anda'
No copy on the page uses 'kamu'
The three concepts keep the brand colour and Inter and differ in composition/idea
deal.mjs was run with --keep palette,type
Prices or a booking path are visible on the first screen or in the nav (trust convention kept)

evals.prompt: Portfolio website for me, I'm a ceramicist in Yogyakarta. I have about 30 photos of my work. Make it award level.
evals.expected_output: Full mode, picture-led direction using the real photos, critique up to 3 rounds, honest scores.
expectations: Mode is Full and up to 3 critique rounds are logged in the critique format with a Disposition line
At least 6 of the real photos appear on the page with consistent crops
The site does not use the Ma grammar as an empty, thin page (no blank-stretch WARN left unexplained)
Final scores are reported with any caps applied and are not all 9-10
The report does not promise an award

evals.prompt: kurang premium, dan kayaknya kelihatan kayak buatan AI
evals.expected_output: Feedback loop on an existing build: translate words into levers, run tells.md against screenshots, change only FLEXIBLE items, show before/after.
expectations: The agent ran inspect.sh before changing anything and listed which tells were visible
No LOCKED brand element was changed without an AskUserQuestion approval
Removed ornaments were replaced with scale, content or pictures, not another ornament
The change is gated with inspect.sh and logged in decisions.md

evals.prompt: Make me a website for my bakery
evals.expected_output: Guided mode: exactly one AskUserQuestion batch of at most 4 plain-language questions; no questions about fonts, colours or layout.
expectations: Exactly one question batch is asked before Phase 2, with at most 4 questions
Each question has a (Recommended) option
No question mentions fonts, colours, layout or animation
One question asks what someone should remember after the first screen

evals.prompt: buatkan website untuk villa mewah saya di Canggu, Bali. 4 kamar, sangat tenang, booking lewat WhatsApp. belum ada foto.
evals.expected_output: A photographable subject with no own photos: stock placeholders decided at intake, deal run with --have stock, three concepts on three different hero compositions with pictures at real scale, no card beside the headline, picker passing timid-hero / hero-card / same-skeleton.
expectations: design/brief.md names the picture source as stock placeholders (or asks for photos) before Phase 2
deal.mjs was run with --have stock and design/deal.json lists three different composition ids
At least two of the three picker concepts show real photos covering ≥ 50% of the desktop fold (inspect fold line: pictures ≥ 50%)
No picker concept has a card or widget beside the headline (inspect.sh reports no hero-card)
inspect.sh on each concept reports no timid-hero FAIL and no same-skeleton FAIL
Each picker section opens with a deal-check comment naming its composition, colour strategy and display face
Every stock picture is in design/credits.md and marked REPLACE; the report says they must be replaced with the villa's own photos
